Raise: Not done. This assertion now accepts Forge's `git -C` advice without checking that a Windows user can run it. `src/forge/nextstep.py:796` formats the path with `shlex.quote`, which puts single quotes around a normal Windows path containing backslashes. `cmd.exe` requires double quotes for paths, so following the printed `pull` command fails; the worktree-removal advice at `nextstep.py:802` has the same problem. The changed test makes that real Windows defect pass. See [Microsoft's cmd documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows-server/administration/windows-commands/cmd).
